name: Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A classic sweet potato casserole with a crunchy pecan topping.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel, cut up, and boil the sweet potatoes until tender. Mash to make 3 cups.
Stir in the beaten eggs, melted butter, evaporated milk, and vanilla into the mashed sweet potatoes. Mix well.
Pour the sweet potato mixture into a baking dish.
Prepare the topping by mixing together the pecans, brown sugar, flour, and melted butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the sweet potato mixture.
Bake at 350 °F for 40 minutes.

keywords: sweet potato casserole, pecan topping, holiday side dish

_similar.name: Sliced Baked Potatoes
_similar.description: A simple yet elegant baked potato dish featuring thinly sliced potatoes topped with melted cheddar and Parmesan cheese, and fresh herbs.
recipeIngredient: 2-3 Tbsp fresh chopped herbs (such as parsley, chives, thyme, or sage)

recipeInstructions.text: Scrub and rinse the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes crosswise into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use the handle of a wooden spoon on either side of the potato to guide the knife.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and fan them slightly.
Drizzle the potatoes with melted butter and sprinkle with fresh herbs.
Bake at 425°F for about 50 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheddar and Parmesan cheese and return to the oven until the cheese is lightly browned and the potatoes are soft inside.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, sliced potatoes, cheesy potatoes, herbed potatoes

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Ham Casserole

½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish
